About.title: From IoT tinkering to trustworthy AI
About.p1: I started with a B.Tech in Computer Science at Lovely Professional University, with a specialisation in IoT. In 2023 I became a co-inventor on a patent for an internet controlled pet food dispenser.
About.p2: At Coschool I built an AI tutor that reached 1,000+ beta users. That work taught me a model is only as good as how you test it.
About.p3: I moved to Germany for an MSc in AI. Now I am building Klindok, and writing a thesis on whether synthetic health data is useful and private.
About.years: years building ML and LLM systems

ResearchHome.title: Research and academic work
ResearchHome.coreP1: My thesis asks whether synthetic health data can be useful and private under GDPR.
ResearchHome.coreP2: Klindok keeps clinical data offline, so the model does not need to leave the practice.
ResearchHome.coreP3: My agent work looks at why reported adoption swings so widely, and which design patterns hold up in real deployments.
ResearchHome.thesisBody: An LLM agent that checks if synthetic health data is useful and private under GDPR.
ResearchHome.agentsBody: Compared four 2026 surveys where reported adoption ranged from 17% to 65%, and traced why.
ResearchHome.patternsBody: ReAct, Reflection, Planning, Tool use and Multi-agent, matched to real deployments and to MCP and A2A.
